title: Measure report type
description: One Measure-stage report as a typed page. Emitted mechanically by the Measure heads — tuesday prices decisions from door-stamped work-item pages (machine time and human gate actions; never hours-shaped fiction); pulse's qualitative aggregate joins when it un-parks. Adoption evidence, harness-queryable beside the decisions it attributes to.

status.description: Content lifecycle state. Mechanical reports are emitted `active`: deterministic tool output, not model prose.

period.description: The calendar month the report covers (YYYY-MM); reports are keyed to explicit months by decision.

source.description: Where the underlying signal came from (e.g. "gitea:como", "github:acme", a survey id).

human_gates.description: Human attention spent at the gates (counts of door-witnessed actions): sign-offs given, stories/projects closed, bounces issued, knocks the merge door refused. Counters are lifetime-to-date on the items involved.

decisions.description: Per decision reference (ADR-NNNN): what landed in the period and what it cost in the two real currencies — machine milliseconds between claim and the merge door, and human gate actions. Attribution is the graph (task -> story -> project -> implements -> decision), never a label convention.

unattributed.description: Work landed in the period whose graph walk reaches no decision — genuinely orphaned, called out rather than hidden.

discarded.description: Cancelled work items to date: planning that was paid for and set aside, and any execution time they carried.

last_updated.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the report was emitted

confidence.description: Certainty of this page's content. Mechanical reports normally omit it (search-neutral, never stale).

citations.description: Pinned path@commit evidence refs (non-edge; interim until llm-wiki#8).

superseded_by.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the replacement page
